de: Great Ormond St Hospital for Sick Children, the first hospital in England to provide in-patient beds specifically for children, is founded in London.

t: 废奴主义者弗雷德里克·道格拉斯 (Frederick Douglass) 发表了他的“七月四日…

dz: 废奴主义者弗雷德里克·道格拉斯 (Frederick Douglass) 发表了他的“七月四日对奴隶来说是什么？”在纽约罗切斯特罗切斯特妇女反奴隶制协会组织的一次会议上的演讲。
de: Abolitionist Frederick Douglass delivers his "What to the Slave Is the Fourth of July?" speech at a meeting organized by the Rochester Ladies' Anti-Slavery Society in Rochester, New York.

t: 哈佛大学赢得了耶鲁大学和哈佛大学之间的首届划船比赛。该比赛也被称为美国有史以来第一个校际体育赛…
te: Harvard University wins the first Boat Race between Yale University and Harvard. The race is also known as the first ev…
dz: 哈佛大学赢得了耶鲁大学和哈佛大学之间的首届划船比赛。该比赛也被称为美国有史以来第一个校际体育赛事。
de: Harvard University wins the first Boat Race between Yale University and Harvard. The race is also known as the first ever American intercollegiate athletic event.
